name: LanguageTool
tagline: A grammar, spelling and style checker that works in more than 30 languages.
about: LanguageTool checks writing in many languages, with browser extensions and add-ons for common writing apps. Its core is open source.
pros: Open-source core that can be self-hosted.
Browser extensions and add-ons for common writing apps.
cons: The free plan limits text length per check.
Style suggestions are weaker in smaller languages.
